item.description: Telluride Ski Resort could be in for a bumpy start of the 2025-26 season, as the Telluride Professional Ski Patrol Association (TPSPA) has authorized a strike against Telluride (Telski). item.title: 2 Epic Pass Midwest Resorts Open This Week as Arctic Blast Hits Much of the Region
item.description: Afton Alps in Minnesota opened on Thursday, and Wilmot in Wisconsin will open today for the 2025-26 season. These two Vail-owned resorts opened with bitterly cold temperatures, with highs only in the upper 20s on Friday, and the lows below zero by Sunday.
